name: OpenAlex
summary: Open catalog of the world's scholarly works, authors, institutions, venues, topics and funders.
description: OpenAlex indexes scholarly works with citations, authorships, affiliations, open-access status, topics and funders, as a free replacement for Microsoft Academic Graph. The API supports rich filtering, grouping, search, sampling and cursor paging. As of 2026 usage is metered in a daily dollar budget rather than fixed request counts.

auth.notes: Works keyless within a small shared per-IP daily budget; a free key gives your own budget. A key can also be requested via POST /api-keys with an email.

rate_limit.summary: Keyless: shared budget of about $0.10/day per IP (~1000 credits, x-ratelimit-limit-usd: 0.1). Free key: $1/day. A list query costs about $0.001; singleton lookups cost less.

coverage.temporal: Continuously updated; hundreds of millions of works

agent_notes: Use select= to trim large responses and cursor paging for deep result sets. Get a free key early because the keyless budget is tiny and shared per IP; check response headers for remaining credit. Use the S3 snapshot for bulk needs.
caveats: Limits changed to a USD-credit model; keyless use is small and shared per IP.
Behavior of the old mailto polite pool is unverified.

verification.notes: Keyless call succeeded; response meta carries a notice describing the budget-based keying.

hn.title: OpenAlex: A free and open catalog of the world's scholarly papers
